top_choice_rationale: Sequencing by synthesis rests on identifiable molecular design (reversible 3'-blocked fluorescent nucleotides, polymerase incorporation, clonal readout), has been reproduced independently at massive scale for two decades, and changed what researchers and clinicians can do. The two-name Balasubramanian and Klenerman allocation with a citation limited to the reversible-terminator step is defensible, though Rothberg, Ju and Mayer have parallel claims. P004 is next as a chemically grounded delivery principle with broad support but a contested trio; P001 has the cleanest attribution but is more incremental to the 2010 prize; P003 pairs two unrelated achievements and base editing follows closely after the 2020 CRISPR prize.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; mild overlap in peptide, lipid and self-assembly research with Emma Sparr, who proposes P004, but not a disqualifying connection
